description: She wears a long dark forest-green dress and matching layered overdress, with a fitted bodice, low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-brown woven knotwork borders decorate the neckline, shoulder strips, waist, front and hem. Two circular brooch fittings sit near the shoulders and a decorated belt has a circular buckle. A cream textured underdress is visible at the central skirt opening. A substantial green and gold patterned wrap rests along the forearms and drapes down both sides. A small bracelet and ring are visible. Brown shoes appear below the full-length opaque skirt. Upper chest is exposed while bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis remain covered.
